    s = Session("sit_hard", instance="/app/instance.npz")
    s.reset()
    lo, hi = s.low.model.actuator_ctrlrange.T
    # The first target makes fast contact with the chair. The second target

    fast_q = np.array([
        -0.06, 0.09, -1.12, 0.82, 0.09,
        -0.06, -0.09, -1.12, 0.82, 0.09,
        0.0, -0.55, 0.04, 0.13, 1.2,
        -0.55, -0.04, -0.13, 1.2,
    ])
    seated_q = np.array([
        -0.01865, 0.18535, -0.95388, 0.97701, -0.23636,
        -0.01865, -0.18535, -0.95388, 0.97701, -0.23636,
        0.0, 0.41017, -0.02508, 0.34749, 0.52729,
        0.41017, 0.02508, -0.34749, 0.52729,
    ])
    fast_action = np.clip(2 * (fast_q - lo) / (hi - lo) - 1, -1, 1)
    seated_action = np.clip(2 * (seated_q - lo) / (hi - lo) - 1, -1, 1)
